issue_context.title: make the default value of `ttl_job_interval` to a larger value
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

If a user does not specify the `ttl_job_interval` when creating a TTL table, it will use `1h` as the default value. However, this default value seems to make the job runs too frequently and have some performance effect on the cluster. It's better to make the default value to `24h` to avoid this.
